dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of admissible runs of dimension n. Via its constructor, a run packages a floating-point format, a proof that n>0, real matrices A and R_hat, structural assumptions on them, and execution evidence for every required matrix entry.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the universally quantified domain and supplies every hypothesis and datum used by the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the run's real n-by-n matrix A.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides A in all residual bounds and in the identity R_hat^T R_hat=A+Delta A.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the run's real n-by-n computed matrix R_hat.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the matrix whose representability, local residual bounds, and product perturbation are asserted.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the run's floating-point format.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the representability predicate and unit roundoff used directly in the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: The representability predicate of a floating-point format.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The first conclusion says every entry of R_hat satisfies this predicate; it also occurs in the packaged run assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The unit-roundoff real number u of a floating-point format.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the factor u in every componentwise error and perturbation bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: For matrices X and Y, it is the componentwise absolute product (|X||Y|)_{ij}=sum over k<n of |X_{ik}| |Y_{kj}|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With X=R_hat^T and Y=R_hat, it gives W_{ij}=sum over k<n of |R_hat_{ki}| |R_hat_{kj}| in both Delta A bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: For R and indices i,j, it is sum over k<i of |R_{ki}| |R_{kj}| plus |R_{ii}| |R_{ij}|, equivalently sum over 0<=k<=i of those absolute products.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the nonnegative scale S_{ij} in the off-diagonal and diagonal local residual bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: For R and indices i,j, it is sum over k<i of R_{ki}R_{kj} plus R_{ii}R_{ij}, equivalently sum over 0<=k<=i of R_{ki}R_{kj}.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the partial inner product subtracted from A_{ij} in the local residual bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary real matrix multiplication: (XY)_{ij}=sum over k<n of X_{ik}Y_{kj}.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied to R_hat^T and R_hat, it forms the exact product in the perturbation identity.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: Matrix transpose, defined by (X^T)_{ij}=X_{ji}.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Turns the product in the existential conclusion into R_hat^T R_hat and turns D007 into sums |R_hat_{ki}| |R_hat_{kj}|.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor for a run: it takes a format F, n>0, matrices A and R_hat, representability of every A entry, symmetry of A, upper-triangularity R_hat_{ij}=0 when j<i, off-diagonal execution evidence for every i<j, and diagonal execution evidence for every j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These constructor arguments are the assumptions implicit in quantifying over run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of floating-point formats described by radix, precision, exponent bounds, representability, safe-range and rounding operations, unit roundoff, and their axioms.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines representability and u directly and restricts which execution traces can form a run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: The strict-prefix absolute inner product sum over k<i: sum |R_{ki}| |R_{kj}|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the k=i term, it expands D008 into S_{ij}.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: The strict-prefix inner product sum over k<i: sum R_{ki}R_{kj}.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the k=i term, it expands D009 into the partial inner product C_{ij}.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of evidence that a diagonal entry R_{jj} was produced by an admissible diagonal square-root execution associated with F, A, and R.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: One such witness for every j is required inside a run, restricting the universally quantified runs.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of evidence that an off-diagonal entry R_{ij} was produced by an admissible dot-product, subtraction, and division execution associated with F, A, and R.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: One such witness is required for every i<j inside a run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor for a floating-point format. It requires radix beta>=2, precision p>0, integer exponent bounds e_min<e_max, a finite representable set whose members are 0 or m beta^(e-(p-1)) with integer |m|<beta^p and e_min<=e<=e_max, a safe-range predicate, rounding map, and 0<=u<=1/2 with 2u beta^(p-1)=1. It also requires representability of 0 and 1, sign closure, safe inputs rounding to representable values, nearest-representable rounding, |round(x)-x|<=u|round(x)| on the safe range, preservation of nonnegativity, the stated rounded-square-root error bound, and exact rounding of representable values.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the exact arithmetic model behind every run and guarantees in particular that u is nonnegative and zero is representable.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical embedding of an index k in Fin(i) into Fin(n), preserving its natural value; it represents an index k<i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the prefix sums and trace vectors range exactly over 0<=k<i.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: Builds diagonal execution evidence from a length-j square-root execution whose two input vectors are both R_{kj} for k<j, whose scalar c is A_{jj}, and whose output is R_{jj}, with matching format.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Specifies exactly how every packaged diagonal trace is tied to A and R_hat.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: Builds off-diagonal execution evidence from a length-i execution with a_k=R_{ki}, b_k=R_{kj}, divisor bK=R_{ii}, scalar c=A_{ij}, output R_{ij}, and matching format.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Specifies exactly how every packaged i<j trace is tied to A and R_hat.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: Proof that if s is an index below k.val and k is below n, then s.val<n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Justifies the prefix-index embedding used in sums and traces; it adds no numerical assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of length-m off-diagonal arithmetic executions, containing vectors, divisor, scalar, reduction data, error evidence, and an output.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its inhabitants underlie the off-diagonal evidence required by a run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the first input vector a from an off-diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D021 identifies it with k mapped to R_hat_{ki}.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the second input vector b from an off-diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D021 identifies it with k mapped to R_hat_{kj}.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the divisor or pivot bK from an off-diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D021 identifies it with R_hat_{ii}; the execution constructor requires it to be representable and nonzero.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the scalar c from an off-diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D021 identifies it with A_{ij}.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the floating-point format from an off-diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D021 requires it to equal the run's format.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the computed output yHat from an off-diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D021 identifies it with R_hat_{ij}.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of length-m diagonal square-root executions, containing two vectors, a scalar, reduction data, error evidence, and an output.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its inhabitants underlie the diagonal evidence required by a run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the first input vector a from a diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D020 identifies it with k mapped to R_hat_{kj}.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the second input vector b from a diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D020 also identifies it with k mapped to R_hat_{kj}.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the scalar c from a diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D020 identifies it with A_{jj}.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the floating-point format from a diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D020 requires it to equal the run's format.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the computed output yHat from a diagonal execution.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D020 identifies it with R_hat_{jj}.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor for an off-diagonal execution. Inputs a_i,b_i,bK,c are representable, bK is nonzero, and every a_i b_i is safe. It chooses a binary reduction tree and permutation for the leaves c and -round(a_i b_i), requires representable leaves and safe internal additions, defines numerator as the rounded tree reduction, assumes the D040 certificate with exact correction -sum a_i b_i and magnitude sum |a_i b_i|, and outputs numerator if bK=1 or round(numerator/bK) after a safe division otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the precise arithmetic restriction imposed on each off-diagonal entry in an admissible run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructor for a diagonal execution. Representable vectors a,b and scalar c have safe products; a tree and permutation reduce c and -round(a_i b_i) by safe rounded additions to numerator; a D040 certificate is required with exact correction -sum a_i b_i and magnitude sum |a_i b_i|. The numerator must be nonnegative, its square root safe, and yHat=round(sqrt(numerator)).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With a=b=R_hat's column prefix, this is the precise arithmetic restriction imposed on each diagonal entry.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the rounding function round: Real to Real from a format.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used throughout the execution traces that are embedded in the run.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projection of the safe-range predicate from a format.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Restricts products, additions, divisions, and square roots permitted in execution traces.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: An inductively generated error-certificate relation E_F(q,p,e,s,z) linking a term count q, pivot p, exact correction e, nonnegative magnitude bound s, and final computed value z, with base and composition rules D045 and D046.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Every reduction trace packaged into a run must carry such a certificate; it is not itself asserted in the final conjunction.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of nonempty binary trees indexed by their number of leaves: one leaf has size 1 and joining sizes m,n has size m+n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Specifies arbitrary parenthesizations of rounded reductions in the execution evidence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: For vectors a,b and scalar c, constructs the m+1 reduction leaves: value c at index 0 and -round(a_i b_i) at successor index i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the values reduced to each off-diagonal or diagonal numerator.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: Evaluates a leaf-indexed binary tree: a leaf returns its sole value, and each internal node rounds the sum of the recursively computed child values.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the computed numerator in every execution trace.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef044
dependency_coverage.meaning: Validity of a rounded tree reduction: each leaf value is representable, each child reduction is valid, and every unrounded sum of child results lies in the format's safe range.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Ensures each internal addition used by a packaged execution is permitted and rounds to a representable value.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef045
dependency_coverage.meaning: Base error certificate: if p is representable, then E_F(1,p,0,0,p).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the one-term base case for the reduction certificates required by runs.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef046
dependency_coverage.meaning: Composition rule for error certificates. If p is representable, q_s>0, s_s>=0, |e_s|<=s_s, z_s is representable, |z_s-e_s|<=q_s u s_s, p+z_s is safe, and E_F(q_o,round(p+z_s),e_o,s_o,z), then E_F(q_o+q_s,p,e_s+e_o,s_s+s_o,z).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines how the packaged reduction error evidence is assembled and where factors count times u arise.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef047
dependency_coverage.meaning: A dependent product structure collecting recursive motive values and recursive payloads for all subtrees of a binary tree.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Implementation support for tree folds D043 and D044; it adds no independent mathematical condition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef048
dependency_coverage.meaning: A tree fold that computes a motive value from the recursively collected subtree data.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Implements the rounded reduction and validity definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef049
dependency_coverage.meaning: The one-leaf binary tree.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the base shape for reductions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef050
dependency_coverage.meaning: The binary-tree node constructor joining trees with m and n leaves into one with m+n leaves.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides arbitrary binary association of the execution reductions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef051
dependency_coverage.meaning: The rounded product round(a_i b_i).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These rounded products are negated to form the non-scalar leaves of each numerator reduction.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef052
dependency_coverage.meaning: Proof of the natural-number fact 0<1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Justifies selecting the unique entry of a one-leaf vector; it has no numerical content beyond indexing.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef053
dependency_coverage.meaning: A structural eliminator for a leaf-indexed binary tree and its value vector, with leaf and node cases.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Implements recursive evaluation and validation of reductions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef054
dependency_coverage.meaning: A tree fold returning both the requested motive value and the recursively assembled subtree payload.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Implementation machinery for D048 only.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef055
dependency_coverage.meaning: A nondependent structural recursor for binary trees with leaf and node cases.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used internally to implement tree recursion; it adds no proposition-level restriction.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef056
dependency_coverage.meaning: The primitive dependent recursor for the indexed binary-tree type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Foundational implementation of the tree computations used in execution evidence.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Combines representability, two local bounds, and the existential perturbation statement, including both perturbation bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Exact equality in the relevant type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses exact function-valued matrix equality and the equalities embedded in execution records.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Existential quantification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Introduces the witness Delta A, whose entries may depend on the whole run.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin(n), the finite index type consisting of natural values strictly below n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes every matrix n-by-n and every matrix index zero-based in the range 0,...,n-1.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.val
dependency_coverage.meaning: The underlying natural value of a finite index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Produces the exact coefficients i+1, j+2, and i+2 and defines the order condition i<j.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Context-dependent addition; here it denotes natural addition, real addition, or pointwise matrix addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms index-dependent constants, sums, and A+Delta A.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Context-dependent multiplication; in the target it is ordinary real multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms coefficient times unit-roundoff times sum scales and matrix-product terms.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Context-dependent subtraction; in the target it is ordinary real subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms the residuals A_{ij}-C_{ij}.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: The less-than-or-equal relation from the relevant ordered type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses every componentwise bound and the format side conditions.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The strict less-than relation from the relevant ordered type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Restricts the off-diagonal clause to zero-based indices i<j and occurs in run validity conditions.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the dimension, finite-index values, counts, and integer-valued bound coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: Canonical casting of a natural number into the target numeric type, here usually Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets i+1, j+2, i+2, n+1, and trace counts as real multiplicative factors.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interpretation of a natural numeral in a type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the literal constants 0, 1, and 2 occurring throughout the definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: Pi.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Pointwise addition of functions when their values have addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes (A+Delta A)_{ij}=A_{ij}+Delta A_{ij} in the exact matrix identity.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrix entries, perturbations, roundoff quantities, sums, and bounds are real-valued.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary addition on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets all real sums and pointwise matrix addition.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive-group structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports subtraction, negation, and absolute value.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ordinary order relation <= on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Gives the standard meaning to all displayed inequalities.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Gives the standard meaning to matrix products and error-bound factors.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard embedding of natural numbers into the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Turns the natural count coefficients in the bounds into real numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary real subtraction, implemented as addition of the negative.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets all residual differences.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.lattice
dependency_coverage.meaning: The lattice order structure on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports the absolute-value operation.

dependency_coverage.name: abs
dependency_coverage.meaning: Absolute value, defined as max(x,-x) in the ordered additive group.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes all target bounds scalar absolute-value and componentwise absolute-product bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: instAddNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary natural-number addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms i+1, j+2, i+2, n+1, and tree leaf counts.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous addition interface induced by an ordinary Add instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes overloaded addition to natural, real, or pointwise function addition.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous multiplication interface induced by an ordinary Mul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes overloaded products to ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous subtraction interface induced by an ordinary Sub instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes overloaded differences to real or integer subtraction as appropriate.

dependency_coverage.name: instLTNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary strict order on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets i.val<j.val, n>0, prefix indices, and positive counts.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural numeral n interpreted as itself.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies natural constants in dimensions and coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite enumeration of all elements of Fin(n).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Allows every D007, D010, D014, and D015 sum to range over exactly its finite index set.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: Finite summation in an additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines all matrix products, prefix inner products, and absolute-product sums.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite set of all elements of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes each sum cover all k<n or all k<i, according to its index type.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive commutative-monoid structure of the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides real finite sums, including value 0 for an empty sum.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real number zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Used for empty sums, upper-triangular zero entries, and format and certificate base cases.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interpretation of numeral 0 from a type's zero element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies literal zero in real-valued definitions and conditions.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Division supplied by a division-inverse monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports off-diagonal division and the format normalization expression.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toZPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Integer exponentiation in a division-inverse monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets beta raised to the integer exponent e-(p-1) in the format's representability characterization.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.mk
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs a finite index from a natural value and proof that it is below the bound.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Implements prefix-index embeddings and the zero-based indices used by reductions.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Context-dependent division.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms numerator/bK in off-diagonal executions.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Context-dependent exponentiation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms radix powers in the floating-point format axioms and squares in the square-root axiom.

dependency_coverage.name: Int
dependency_coverage.meaning: The integers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides signed mantissas and exponent bounds in the format representation model.

dependency_coverage.name: Int.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: Canonical casting of an integer into a target numeric type, here Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets the signed mantissa m as a real number in represented values.

dependency_coverage.name: Int.instLEInt
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary <= on integers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses e_min<=e<=e_max in the format model.

dependency_coverage.name: Int.instLTInt
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary strict order on integers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses e_min<e_max.

dependency_coverage.name: Int.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary integer subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms the represented-value exponent e-(p-1).

dependency_coverage.name: Int.natAbs
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural absolute value |m| of an integer m.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Bounds the mantissa magnitude by beta^p.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Natural-number exponentiation in a monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets beta^p and beta^(p-1) where the exponent is natural.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instAtLeastTwoHAddOfNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Proof that n+1 is at least two when n is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Typeclass support for interpreting larger natural numerals; it adds no mathematical hypothesis to the target.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative monoid structure of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports the natural power beta^p in the mantissa bound.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.instNeZeroSucc
dependency_coverage.meaning: Proof that n+1 is nonzero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Typeclass support for numeral and power operations; it contributes no extra proposition-level condition.

dependency_coverage.name: Neg.neg
dependency_coverage.meaning: Unary negation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms negative rounded products and negative exact dot-product sums in execution traces.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interpretation of numeral 1 from a type's multiplicative identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies real and algebraic occurrences of 1, including the bK=1 branch.

dependency_coverage.name: Or
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical disjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Appears in the format axiom classifying each representable value as zero or as having a mantissa-exponent representation.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real multiplicative structure with inverse, division, and integer powers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Gives standard real division and signed radix powers in the format and execution definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instIntCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard embedding of integers into the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Casts signed mantissas and integer-related quantities in the format model.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative monoid structure of the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports natural powers and products in the format axioms.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNeg
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary negation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets negative products, subtraction, and sign closure.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne

binders: n is an implicit natural number.
run is universally quantified over admissible n-dimensional runs. Write F for its format, A and R_hat for its real n-by-n matrices, and u for F's unit roundoff.
Every displayed matrix index i,j ranges over Fin(n), hence has zero-based natural value in {0,...,n-1}. Prefix indices k<i range over {0,...,i-1}.
Delta A is an existentially quantified real n-by-n matrix and may depend on the complete run.
hypotheses: Because run is an inhabitant of LocalDef001(n), it contains a proof n>0.

F is a finite floating-point format with radix beta>=2, precision p>0, integer exponent bounds e_min<e_max, finite representable set, safe-range predicate, rounding operation, and unit roundoff 0<=u<=1/2 satisfying 2u beta^(p-1)=1. Its representable values, rounding, safe-range, nearest-rounding, relative-error, nonnegativity, square-root-error, and exact-on-representables properties are exactly those specified by D018.
Every A_{ij} is representable, A is symmetric, and R_hat is upper triangular in the explicit sense R_hat_{ij}=0 whenever j<i.

For every i<j, the run contains an off-diagonal execution with a_k=R_hat_{ki}, b_k=R_hat_{kj} for k<i, divisor R_hat_{ii}, scalar A_{ij}, and output R_hat_{ij}. Thus these inputs are representable, R_hat_{ii} is nonzero, each product is safe, and the output is obtained from an admissibly permuted binary rounded reduction of A_{ij} and -round(R_hat_{ki}R_hat_{kj}), followed by the constructor's exact or rounded-division branch and its D040 error certificate.

For every j, the run contains a diagonal execution with both prefix vectors equal to k mapped to R_hat_{kj}, scalar A_{jj}, and output R_hat_{jj}. Its admissibly permuted binary rounded reduction has the required D040 certificate, produces a nonnegative numerator with safe square root, and R_hat_{jj} is the rounded square root.

For clarity, the D040 relation E_F(q,p,e,s,z) is the least relation with base E_F(1,p,0,0,p) for representable p and the composition rule: representable p, q_s>0, s_s>=0, |e_s|<=s_s, representable z_s, |z_s-e_s|<=q_s u s_s, safe p+z_s, and E_F(q_o,round(p+z_s),e_o,s_o,z) imply E_F(q_o+q_s,p,e_s+e_o,s_s+s_o,z).
conclusions: Every entry R_hat_{ij} is representable in F.
There exists a real n-by-n matrix Delta A such that R_hat^T R_hat=A+Delta A exactly as functions, equivalently entrywise.
For that same Delta A and every i,j, both |Delta A_{ij}| <= (i.val+2)u W_{ij} and |Delta A_{ij}| <= (n+1)u W_{ij} hold.
mathematical_definitions: C_{ij}:=sum from k=0 through i.val of R_hat_{ki}R_hat_{kj}. This includes the k=i term.
S_{ij}:=sum from k=0 through i.val of |R_hat_{ki}| |R_hat_{kj}|. This is exactly LocalDef008(R_hat,i,j).
W_{ij}:=sum from k=0 through n-1 of |R_hat_{ki}| |R_hat_{kj}|, which is (|R_hat|^T |R_hat|)_{ij} in componentwise absolute-value notation.
(R_hat^T R_hat)_{ij}:=sum from k=0 through n-1 of R_hat_{ki}R_hat_{kj}.

A binary rounded reduction returns its single leaf unchanged at a leaf and returns round(left_result+right_result) at an internal node. Its validity requires representable leaves and safe-range unrounded sums at every internal node. The trace permits an arbitrary permutation of leaves and an arbitrary binary tree.

In an off-diagonal trace for i<j, the leaves before permutation are A_{ij} and -round(R_hat_{ki}R_hat_{kj}) for k<i. If their rounded reduction is N, its certificate is E_F(i.val+1,A_{ij},-sum_{k<i}R_hat_{ki}R_hat_{kj},sum_{k<i}|R_hat_{ki}R_hat_{kj}|,N). The output is N when R_hat_{ii}=1 and otherwise round(N/R_hat_{ii}) after a safe division.

In a diagonal trace for j, the leaves before permutation are A_{jj} and -round(R_hat_{kj}^2) for k<j. If their rounded reduction is N, its certificate is E_F(j.val+1,A_{jj},-sum_{k<j}R_hat_{kj}^2,sum_{k<j}|R_hat_{kj}^2|,N); additionally N>=0, sqrt(N) is safe, and R_hat_{jj}=round(sqrt(N)).
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every positive dimension and every admissible floating-point run containing a representable symmetric real matrix A, an upper-triangular computed matrix R_hat, and the specified rounded off-diagonal and diagonal execution traces, all entries of R_hat are representable. Each upper-triangular off-diagonal residual A_{ij}-sum_{k<=i}R_hat_{ki}R_hat_{kj} is bounded in absolute value by (i+1)u times the corresponding absolute partial inner product, while each diagonal residual has coefficient (j+2)u. Moreover, one can choose a single perturbation matrix Delta A for which R_hat^T R_hat=A+Delta A exactly and each entry satisfies both the row-dependent bound (i+2)u sum_k |R_hat_{ki}| |R_hat_{kj}| and the uniform bound (n+1)u times the same full absolute inner product.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The theorem quantifies only over packaged admissible runs; it does not assert that such a run exists for any given n, format, or matrix.
Although n is syntactically any natural number, a run contains n>0. Consequently the assertion is vacuous at n=0 and also for any parameters for which no execution package can be constructed.
All indices are zero-based. Thus the literal factors are i.val+1, j.val+2, i.val+2, and n+1, not one-based index labels silently shifted again.
The local off-diagonal residual bound is stated only for i<j. No corresponding clause is directly asserted for i>j.
All bounds are entrywise absolute-value bounds. No matrix norm, vector norm, relative matrix error, spectral bound, or condition-number statement is encoded.

No positive-definiteness, semidefiniteness, nonsingularity, diagonal positivity, or global existence condition for a factorization is asserted. Nonnegative square-root numerators and nonzero off-diagonal pivots occur only as requirements of the packaged execution traces.
The off-diagonal trace requires R_hat_{ii} to be nonzero whenever an index j>i exists. For a final diagonal index, and in dimension one, this requirement need not arise.
There is no smallness assumption such as nu<1 and no denominator of the form 1-nu in any displayed conclusion.

Both perturbation bounds are conjunctively present for the same witness. Since i.val<n, u>=0, and W_{ij}>=0, the row-dependent coefficient i.val+2 is at most n+1, so the first bound mathematically implies the second, but the Lean proposition explicitly includes both.
The exact identity defines Delta A relative to A and R_hat, but the substantive claim is that this same witness obeys the stated componentwise bounds.
No uniqueness of Delta A, execution tree, permutation, rounded numerator, or run is asserted.
The safe-range assumptions apply only at the operations explicitly recorded by the execution constructors; the conclusion does not state a general absence-of-overflow property outside those traces.
